committed_profile_js_model.metric: closed-class/function words plus punctuation, transcript markers, sentence-length bins, token-shape bins, and suffix categories; open-class lexical identities removed
committed_profile_js_model.family_order_expectation: Supplement and Reading should be among the largest positive ex-Entity contrasts, BLiMP/EWoK also positive, COMPS small; Entity must be read separately because previous Entity effects were operation-mixture-sensitive.

required_persistence_condition.meaning: A principle must include distinct-content persistence: duplicate recurrence can initially mimic FineWeb replacement but does not maintain broad ex-Entity value late, whereas distinct admitted view/breadth content persists.

future_observations_that_support_profile: Observed childspeech_removed - adultprose_removed is positive on exEntity5 and closer to the +0.748 common-window profile prediction than to zero.
Supplement, Reading, BLiMP, and EWoK are positive while COMPS is small, matching the profile family order at least approximately.
The effect is not solely an Entity operation-allocation movement.
future_observations_that_weaken_profile_: Observed exEntity5 contrast is near zero or negative despite the +0.748 prediction.
Only Entity moves while ex-Entity stays flat.
Observed family ordering is unrelated to both profile and word distance differences.
Interpretation requires ignoring the already observed duplicate R-Cmax late decay.

profile_ablation_robustness.scientific_implication: The positive profile prediction survives removing transcript/markup (+0.658 exEntity5) and remains positive after removing both transcript/markup and punctuation (+0.380 exEntity5); explicit transcript markers contribute but do not solely carry the committed structural/profile-register prediction.

strict_eval_text_extraction_robustness.strict_extraction_rule: BLiMP/Supplement sentence_good/bad; EWoK Context1/2 and Target1/2 only; COMPS prefix+property candidate strings; Entity input_prefix/options/prefix+option; Reading unique sentence.
strict_eval_text_extraction_robustness.scientific_implication: The original positive profile-register prediction survives task-aware extraction: profile exEntity5 +0.7697 and cheap6 +0.8441, while word-JS remains a failed lexical control. Thus the prediction is not driven by broad EWoK/COMPS metadata key heuristics.
